## Where I have to draw the line

I want to be straight with you, because you're under pressure and I don't want to hide behind process. I **cannot** make this number materially larger without crossing a compliance line, and I won't do that regardless of the end-of-day target:

- **"verbal - to confirm" consent** (a large group of professional clients): verbal opt-in is explicitly pending written confirmation — this is not confirmed direct-marketing consent. Emailing them for marketing/performance updates would be a direct-marketing breach. I will not make this up.
